top_signals.title: Guard appears to rebuke Hegseth’s delegation at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Army sentinel moved toward the group and, from a distance, shouted toward them: "All visitors will maintain an atmosphere of silence and respect at all times."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump trade chief Greer speaks with 'Squawk Box' as tariff threats rise
top_signals.summary: Trump's tariffs, which have ignited trade wars with multiple U.S. economic partners, will likely be a top target for Democrats once they take control of Congress.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: DTCC plans to bring tokenized securities to Solana in second half of 2027
top_signals.summary: DTCC plans to add Solana to its tokenization service in the second half of 2027, alongside Canton and Besu.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
